desc:
Make your own 30 dollar music with a cool new editor to play and share them on Roblox 🎵

🥇 Invite up to 3 others in co-op mode to make songs together
🕹️ Convert tracks into multiple minigame modes to score on the leaderboards
🎹 Supports virtual piano/midi keyboard inputs for the editor
💵 Donate or receive tips from your songs and get Robux

🙏 Credits to GD Colon for the original inspiration ❤️
(this place was meant to add new features to the original, like collabs, minigames and sharing)

If you enjoyed your time, make sure to 👍 It helps players find your cool songs!
